content.text: Line 63 of the relational mapper looks wrong. I'll check it.

candidates.explanation: toPersistence assigns persistenceEntity.lastName = domainEntity.firstName instead of domainEntity.lastName. Every create and update goes through this mapper, so the stored surname is always a copy of the first name. That gives 'Jane Jane' on registration and on later profile edits.

fix.description: Change line 63 to map the last name from the domain entity.
